ideas.text: An AI that takes the Q1 plan and adjusts it for the 14 holidays, 3 sick days, and 2 surprise reorgs already visible.
A bot that detects when OKRs were written by leadership and handed down without asking the team if they're achievable.
An app that converts 'we need to be more ambitious' into a capacity analysis nobody asked for.
A tool that detects when the planning document is longer than the quarter and suggests editing it down to what matters.
An AI that identifies which last quarter's goals were quietly dropped and asks whether they'll appear again this quarter.
A bot that converts 3 competing strategic priorities into a ranked list so the team knows what to actually do first.
An app that detects when Q4 planning starts during Q3 delivery and calculates what that's costing in distraction.
A tool that tracks which dependencies were flagged in planning and which ones blew up exactly as predicted.
An AI that identifies which roadmap items have appeared in every quarter for 18 months and asks what's blocking them.
A bot that converts 'we'll figure it out as we go' into a risk register with owners and deadlines.
An app that detects when a plan requires 120% of available capacity and quietly finds the 20% that has to go.
A tool that flags when a quarterly goal has no measurable success criteria and sends it back for revision.
An AI that detects when two teams' plans have a dependency neither team knows about.
A bot that converts the CEO's all-hands vision into 3 things your specific team can actually do this quarter.
An app that tracks which sprint goals survived contact with reality and which ones became folklore.
A tool that detects when a stakeholder added scope after planning closed and logs the impact on the timeline.
An AI that monitors planning document edits in the final 48 hours and alerts when something significant changed quietly.
A bot that detects when a planning meeting produced no decisions and books a shorter one with a decision owner named.
An app that identifies how much of your team's quarterly capacity is already committed before planning even starts.
A tool that detects when an OKR key result is a project and not a measurable outcome and sends it back for rewriting.
An AI that estimates the probability a plan will survive the first two weeks of the quarter intact.
A bot that maps every cross-team dependency in the plan and asks whether each one has been verbally confirmed.
An app that detects when your team plans for 40 story points and historically ships 22 and adjusts accordingly.
A tool that identifies which planning assumptions are most likely to be wrong by the end of week 4.
An AI that detects when the plan looks great on paper and the team has privately agreed it's not happening.
A bot that generates a one-page summary of the quarterly plan that an engineer could actually use on a Tuesday.
An app that detects when 'we need to move fast this quarter' is said the same week headcount is frozen.
A tool that logs all mid-quarter scope changes, who requested them, and what they displaced from the original plan.
An AI that converts a strategic roadmap into 3 things each team needs to do differently starting Monday.
A bot that detects when a plan is heavy on Q1 goals and suspiciously light on Q4 commitments.
An app that monitors planning document version history and surfaces what changed between the draft and the approved version.
A tool that converts 'tiger team' into a real project plan with a real owner and a real end date.
An AI that detects when a planning session has 20 attendees and produces a plan that could have been written by 3.
A bot that identifies when the same initiative was prioritized 3 quarters in a row without ever starting.
An app that detects when a quarterly theme is just a rebrand of last quarter's theme with different colors.
A tool that generates a realistic midpoint forecast for the quarter and sends it to leadership whether they asked or not.
An AI that detects when a team's morale score dropped right after planning was published and asks why.
A bot that converts every 'we'll revisit this next quarter' into a calendared task so it actually gets revisited.
An app that identifies which goals in the plan are driven by customer need versus internal politics.
A tool that detects when an OKR was written to be achievable rather than ambitious and offers a stretch version.
An AI that identifies the one decision that, if made now, would unblock 40% of the quarterly plan.
A bot that detects when planning ended without aligning on what done looks like for any of the goals.
An app that tracks planning cycle length over time and alerts when it's growing faster than the company's complexity warrants.
A tool that converts a leadership vision deck into the operational questions the team needs answered before they can execute it.
An AI that detects when a quarterly goal requires a headcount that hasn't been approved yet and flags it.
A bot that generates a realistic Q3 plan in the first week of Q3 because the official plan won't be ready until week 3.
An app that detects when a planning retro has been skipped for 4 consecutive quarters and reschedules one with teeth.
A tool that estimates how many slides the quarterly business review deck will be based on how the quarter went.
An AI that identifies which team's plans are most likely to cause problems for your team and flags it for a conversation.
A bot that detects when a plan has no buffer for the unexpected and adds a named contingency owner.
An app that converts the planning document's passive voice into active ownership by putting a name on every commitment.
An AI that detects when a planning session is being used to avoid starting the actual work.
A bot that converts every 'to be determined' in a plan into a deadline for when it needs to be determined.
An app that tracks which quarterly goals were still being discussed in week 11 of a 13-week quarter.
A tool that identifies the one dependency that will break the entire plan and sends it to the right person now.
An AI that converts a strategy deck into a to-do list so someone can actually start on Monday.
A bot that detects when your quarterly planning meeting produces a list of things to plan rather than a plan.
